Title: Flash Forward Vol 1 6

URL Source: https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Flash_Forward_Vol_1_6

Markdown Content:
****_Flash Forward_ #6**** is an issue of the series [_Flash Forward_ (Volume 1)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Flash_Forward_Vol_1 "Flash Forward Vol 1") with a cover date of [April, 2020](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Category:2020,_April "Category:2020, April"). It was published on February 19, 2020.

## Synopsis for "Chapter Six: Nothing ever ends"

_**Inside the Dark world created by Wally West**_

[Wally](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Flash_(Wally_West) "Flash (Wally West)") is living together with the children he once again found: [Iris](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Iris_West_II_(Prime_Earth) "Iris West II (Prime Earth)") and [Jai](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Jai_West_(Prime_Earth) "Jai West (Prime Earth)"), his daughter and his son. He's never been happier in all of his life. But he knows this won't last: if he decides to keep living here, with them, he will condemn all reality to be swallowed by Dark Matter. It seems that, given he was the father of this world, he also passed to his world the ability to correct himself faster then [Entropy](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Entropy "Entropy"), making it unable to be destroyed naturally. And this makes it the center of a plague who might kill every single planet existing.

Wally West is a hero, and knows what he has to do: sit on the [Mobius Chair](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Mobius_Chair "Mobius Chair"), destroying this world and becoming a new creature, with no memories, no past, no identity of himself. He makes [Tempus Fuginaut](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Tempus_Fuginaut_(Prime_Earth) "Tempus Fuginaut (Prime Earth)") promise a thing: he must bring his children home. Tempus accepts it, and Jai and Iris are able to witness the ultimate sacrifice of the Flash, renouncing to himself, to his own identity, for the greater cause.

_**Earth 0. Central City**_

[Linda Park](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Linda_Park_(Prime_Earth) "Linda Park (Prime Earth)") is talking on her cellphone about her show, while Tempus Fuginaut materializes and leaves [Jai](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Jai_West_(Prime_Earth) "Jai West (Prime Earth)") and [Iris](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Iris_West_II_(Prime_Earth) "Iris West II (Prime Earth)") there. And in a moment, everything comes back in the mind of Linda: her son, her daughter, the love for them and for Wally West. Their life together. He is once again that Linda Park, the one in love with the Flash and that built a family with him. Getting out of his house in tears, she embraces Iris and Jai again.

_**Somewhere, in the space between Universes**_

A new creature is born. It is Wally West. No, it was Wally West. Now it is Wally West, and something **more**. It is Wally West and the Mobius Chair, united. It saw all the people who sat on the Chair before: [Batman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Batman_(Bruce_Wayne) "Batman (Bruce Wayne)"). [Owlman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Thomas_Wayne,_Jr._(Earth_3) "Thomas Wayne, Jr. (Earth 3)"). [Metron](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Metron_(Prime_Earth) "Metron (Prime Earth)"). It sees now a man, [a man who obliterated Metron](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Jonathan_Osterman_(Watchmen) "Jonathan Osterman (Watchmen)"). He is creation, doomsday, a clock ticking on the Multiverse. It shares his vision. Speeding across time and space, they are combined something more than anyone who has ever been. Until now, the Chair was made to observe. But now, it is not: today is a new day. A new vocation. A new Wally West.

## Appearing in "Chapter Six: Nothing ever ends"

**Featured Characters:**

*   [The Flash/Wally West (Earth 0)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wally_West_(Prime_Earth) "Wally West (Prime Earth)")_**(Flashback and main story)**_

## Notes

*   Wally West's story continues in [_The Flash_ #750](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/The_Flash_Vol_1_750 "The Flash Vol 1 750").
*   Although it is not clearly stated in this issue, the Mobius Chair empowers Wally West with the [residual energy](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/The_Seven_Forces_of_the_Universe "The Seven Forces of the Universe") of [Doctor Manhattan](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Jonathan_Osterman_(Watchmen) "Jonathan Osterman (Watchmen)"). 
    *   This is represented by Wally's suit becoming blue like Jon Osterman's skin as well as the latter's hydrogen symbol appearing on Wally's forehead.
